newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil edge higher, markets tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil edge higher, markets tight.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil barges were slightly firmer on Tuesday amid a scarcity of product, traders said.

High sulphur barges traded in the morning at $86.50 a tonne fob ARA for very prompt stored material and then stronger prices were seen, with barges changing hands at $87.25, $88, $89, $89.50, $89.75, $90 and possibly $90.50.

High sulphur cargoes were thinly talked although the market was seen in the region of $84 a tonne cif NWE. A trader was heard to have won one cargo in Portugal's latest tender and one dealer said he thought the successful company's bid had been the average of fob NWE mean/fob Med mean +$13.
It was suggested that the second cargo tendered for was not awarded, but this was not confirmed.
Low sulphur markets were little changed despite stronger crude oil futures and dealers said the arbitrage window with the United States appeared to be closed.
One cargo of low sulphur fuel oil was heard available out of Germany, and the offer was heard slightly beneath $96 fob NWE.
